Rork  complete  this now and deploy  live  PARTIAL — only the deterministic pilot fallback (2 commits: PILOT-1→2, PILOT-2→3). The general LLM path that would handle real tasks has NEVER produced a live commit.,  proof evidence and verified FINAL IVX APP FACTORY PILOT
PROVE IVX IA CAN CREATE A COMPLETE APP FROM SCRATCH

Do not return another capability assessment.

Build one real independent pilot application end to end using the IVX autonomous coder.

APPLICATION NAME:
IVX Investor Tracker

This must be separate from the main IVX production application.

==================================================
1. CREATE THE PRODUCT SPECIFICATION
==================================================

Create and persist:

- application purpose
- target users
- owner role
- screens
- navigation
- database model
- API contracts
- business rules
- security rules
- acceptance criteria
- testing plan
- deployment plan

Owner must approve the specification before production deployment.

==================================================
2. CREATE OWNER-CONTROLLED REPOSITORY
==================================================

Create a new repository under the owner’s GitHub account.

Required:

- repository name
- default branch
- README
- license decision
- branch protections
- CI workflow
- issue template
- release workflow

No Rork-controlled repository or proxy.

==================================================
3. CREATE APPLICATION SCAFFOLD
==================================================

Generate a real Expo React Native application with:

- Expo Router
- TypeScript
- owner login
- investor dashboard
- investor list
- investor profile
- add/edit investor
- pipeline stages
- notes
- follow-up tasks
- settings
- error boundaries
- loading and empty states

Use the IVX-owned design system.

==================================================
4. CREATE BACKEND AND DATABASE
==================================================

Create:

- Supabase project or isolated owner-controlled schema
- investors table
- investor activities table
- follow-up tasks table
- owner profiles table
- audit log table
- migrations
- indexes
- RLS policies
- API validation
- authentication and authorization

Do not use fake production data.

==================================================
5. CREATE API LAYER
==================================================

Implement:

- owner authentication
- list investors
- create investor
- update investor
- archive investor
- investor detail
- pipeline stage update
- activity history
- follow-up creation
- dashboard metrics

Return documented request and response schemas.

==================================================
6. AUTONOMOUS CODING REQUIREMENT
==================================================

IVX IA must independently:

- inspect the approved specification
- create the architecture
- create files
- generate code
- run tests
- analyze failures
- revise its patches
- create commits
- push to GitHub
- prepare deployment

Rork must not manually author the application code.

Every task must include:

- task ID
- files inspected
- files created
- files changed
- commands
- tests
- typecheck
- commit SHA
- evidence

==================================================
7. TESTING
==================================================

Run:

- lint
- TypeScript typecheck
- unit tests
- API tests
- database tests
- authentication tests
- RLS tests
- integration tests
- Android smoke tests
- offline/error-state tests

No skipped release-blocking tests.

==================================================
8. BUILD AND DEPLOY
==================================================

Build:

- Android APK
- Android AAB
- web build if included

Deploy:

- backend
- database migrations
- web application if included

Use only owner-controlled services.

==================================================
9. PHYSICAL DEVICE QA
==================================================

Verify on Android:

- install
- launch
- owner login
- create investor
- edit investor
- change pipeline stage
- create follow-up
- restart app
- confirm persistence
- logout/login
- invalid login
- offline recovery
- no crash
